opportunities.point: A automobile & auto components tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that the e-scooter segment delivered revenue of INR217 crores, contributing 73.1% of total revenue.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Delivering a revenue of INR217 crores, contributing 73.1% of total revenue and registering a robust growth of 147.6% year-on-year growth." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The e-rickshaw segment grew exponentially with revenue of INR22 crores, contributing 7.4% of total revenue.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Our e-rickshaw segment has emerged to the fastest-growing vertical, delivering revenue of INR22 crores and contributing 7.4% of total revenue with exponential growth of 5,564.3%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Maxvolt established its presence across 16 states, supported by 12 warehouses, 875 plus dealers and distributors, and 31 plus OEM clients.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "We have now established our presence across 16 states, supported by 12 warehouses, 875 plus dealers and distributors. And 31 plus OEM clients across electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, EPC and customized battery applications." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -0.44 pp, DII -2.26 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Exchange fluctuations, rising dollar pricing, and stretched raw material supply chains impacted EBITDA and PAT slightly.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The dollar pricing is increasing; the raw material supply chain is a bit having a stretch on it. So, bit of the issue of the supply chain and the costing impact, the thing is going to have a minor impact." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: India faces a lack of domestic lithium, cobalt, and nickel reserves.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Lacks domestic lithium, cobalt, nickel reserves." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: India faces capital, talent, and recycling infrastructure gaps.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Faces capital, talent, and recycling infrastructure gaps." (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Mar) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S30/W22/O29/T17), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 68 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
